summary: Site with a 1911 50-foot steel Minnesota Forest Service tower. FFLA says Crow Wing platform, gone; county and statewide lists say Cass tower. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 50-foot steel ladder tower erected 1911, replacing an earlier wooden tower built by the site's namesake
facts.status_note: FFLA lists it gone; no source says when or how the 1911 tower came down

events.note: 50-foot steel ladder tower erected by the Minnesota Forest Service, replacing a wooden tower built by the namesake

evidence.supports: a wooden tower built by the namesake, replaced with a 50-foot steel tower
evidence.quote: Wood tower built by namesake, replaced with 50 foot steel

evidence.supports: replacement in 1911; one of the first towers of the new Minnesota Forest Service
evidence.quote: ladder tower in 1911. One of first towers erected by the new

evidence.supports: Martin Hope is a row on the Cass County list: owner MFS, 1911, 50 feet, ladder

evidence.quote: Minnesota Forest Service, now Mn Department of Natural Resources, Forestry Division

evidence.supports: FFLA lists it in Crow Wing, as a platform, gone
evidence.quote: Martin Hope Crow Wing 46.45221 -94.43125 Platform Gone

evidence.supports: statewide list places it in Cass County, 1911, 50 feet, ladder

corrections.why: The Cass County list describes a 50-foot steel ladder tower erected in 1911; the FFLA list says platform. Low confidence: the two lists are not reconciled.
The Cass County list and the statewide A-Z list both place it in Cass County; the FFLA list says Crow Wing. Coordinates in the record were not checked against county lines.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three lists, no fate or date of removal, and the county and type disagree between the FFLA list and the state lists. The Crow Wing County list on Wikimedia Commons (https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0f/Crow_Wing_County_Towers.pdf) has no Martin Hope entry, which fits the Cass placement. Only one web search turned up nothing usable about the site; the search results were unrelated people and maps. No staffing or fire history found.
